jobs.title: Onderwijsassistent (teaching assistant) — fictional
jobs.body:
FICTIONAL ADVERT
Teaching assistant, 24 hours.
Support small groups with reading and maths. Required: experience with children, Dutch B1, a VOG.
Nice to have: an MBO-4 diploma in education.
jobs.reason: Strong match with my classroom experience. Dutch B1 is required; I am at A2 now.

requirements.evidence: Eight years as a primary school teacher; weekly volunteer homework help.
requirements.nextStep: Prepare one STAR example about the reading group.
Ask if B1 is needed at the start; plan the B1 exam.
Ask the school how they arrange the VOG.

requirements.text: MBO-4 diploma in education (nice to have)
requirements.evidence: Bachelor of Education from abroad; no Dutch evaluation yet.

answers.q1: I taught primary school for eight years. I like helping children who find reading hard.
answers.q2: Six children were behind in reading. I made a small group and extra material. After three months, five of them could read the class book.

notes.q2: Say "I" more clearly. Explain how I measured progress.

priorities: Learn how Dutch primary schools work
plan.nextAction: Book a Dutch B1 practice test.
